ayahs.1: Apne bahut hi buland Allah ke naam ki paakeezgi bayan kar.
ayahs.2: Jis ne paida kiya aur saheeh-saalim banaya.
ayahs.3: Aur jis ne (theek-thaak) andaaza kiya aur phir raah dikhaai.
ayahs.4: Aur jis ne taaza ghaas paida ki.
ayahs.5: Phir us ne us ko (sukha kar) siyaah kooda kar diya.
ayahs.6: Hum tujhe padhaaenge phir tu na bhoolega.
ayahs.7: Magar jo kuchh Allah chaahe. Woh zaahir aur posheeda ko jaanta hai.
ayahs.8: Hum aap ke liye aasaani paida kar denge.
ayahs.9: To aap naseehat karte rahen agar naseehat kuchh faayda de.
ayahs.13: Jahan phir na woh marega na jiyega, (balke haalat-e-naza mein pada rahega).
ayahs.14: Beshak us ne falaah pai jo paak ho gaya.
ayahs.15: Aur jis ne apne Rabb ka naam yaad rakha aur namaz padhta raha.
ayahs.16: Lekin tum to dunya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh dete ho.
ayahs.17: Aur aakhirat bahut behtar aur bahut baqa wali hai.
ayahs.18: Yeh baaten pehli kitaabon mein bhi hain.
ayahs.19: (Yani) Ibraheem aur Moosa ki kitaabon mein.
